# PulseHabour

> Solo developer building tooling for the RAGE engine and the FiveM/Cfx.re ecosystem:
> file format explorers, native reference tools, and developer utilities. Fan tooling
> only — not affiliated with Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, or the Cfx.re project.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pulsehabour.github.io/): what the tools are for and what they cover.
- [CFX Run](https://pulsehabour.github.io/cfxrun/): what the extension does, how the two halves fit together, and how to debug a client on another machine.
- [YARGE](https://pulsehabour.github.io/yarge/): the RPF explorer and world editor in progress.
- [Privacy](https://pulsehabour.github.io/privacy/): what the site collects, which is nothing unless you consent.

## Public projects

- [CFX Run](https://pulsehabour.github.io/cfxrun/): VS Code extension that lets GitHub Copilot Chat execute JavaScript inside a running FiveM or RedM client, for debugging a live session. Published on the [Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=PulseHabour.cfxrun). Development tool only — it can execute any native, so it should not run on a live server.
- [CfxRun-Resource](https://github.com/PulseHabour/CfxRun-Resource): the server side of CFX Run, exposing the execution endpoint the extension calls. MIT licensed.
- [NativeCheck](https://github.com/PulseHabour/NativeCheck): browser-based reference for looking up RAGE natives by name and reading their signatures.
- [NativeViewer](https://github.com/PulseHabour/NativeViewer): Python companion for browsing native definitions on the desktop.

## In development

- [YARGE](https://pulsehabour.github.io/yarge/) (Yet Another RAGE Editor): cross-platform RPF explorer and world editor for RAGE-engine games, aimed at browsing and searching large archives without freezing. Pre-alpha — no public build or repository yet.
- FiveM Stats: server statistics tracking, built on Node and Postgres. Not yet public.
- LuminHub: small Python service, TLS end to end. Not yet public.
